excerpt: A one-eyed Bette Davis celebrates her wedding anniversary, ten years after her husband’s death, by tormenting her three grown sons and the women who love them.
title: The Anniversary

excerpt: In colonial Pennsylvania, frontiersman John Wayne leads his fellow colonists against crooked merchants, Indian raiders, and an arrogant British captain.
title: Allegheny Uprising

excerpt: Trapped inside a 1990s children’s show, a group of kids plot their escape from Buddy, a cheerful magical unicorn who will kill anyone who spoils the fun.
title: Buddy

excerpt: Vacationing wife Barbara Stanwyck races the tide to keep her husband from drowning, and the only man she finds is escaped convict Ralph Meeker, who sees something he wants.
title: Jeopardy

excerpt: Mobster Jack Nicholson falls into a chemical vat and emerges with white skin, green hair, a rictus grin, and a plan to remake Gotham City in his image.
title: Batman
